name: url
label: URL
help: Facebook post or Reel URL. Omit when feedbackId is set.

name: feedbackId
label: Feedback ID
help: Post feedback id from /v1/facebook/details. Prefer when you already have it.

name: limit
label: Limit
help: Max items to return. Default 50, max 500. Flat 2 credits per call.

name: cache
label: Cache
help: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache. Default false — always fetch fresh data.
